notes: The opening that is the complementizer of the ויהי frame begun in v.1, carried by this clause's own apodosis waw under rule 45.

MACULA's reversed glosses on the suffixed construct nouns (זקניו, ראשיו, שפטיו, שטריו) are a display defect under rule 39; each suffix takes their and each noun its own word, as the accepted units have it.
The and between זקנתי and באתי is added, exactly as in v.1: no conjunction morpheme stands between them.
